rules.statement: A tenant's liability to pay rent is not discharged merely because the landlord has accepted cheques in part payment and subsequently returned them, nor does such action render the tenant in default for a period of one month if they fail to pay within a reasonable time thereafter.
rules.supporting_quote: "Moreover, the rent can be in arrear only from the day on which it became due, which is fixed by the terms of the contract of tenancy and cannot be varied by the unilateral act of the landlord in returning a cheque that he has taken as conditional payment. "

meta.parties: Subbiahpillai v. M. A. Sheriff & Co., Ltd
